skills.description_zh: Turns scattered work traces — commit logs, task notes, chat dumps, meeting notes, a plain bullet list — into a daily or weekly work report that a manager can actually read. Every finished item carries evidence (artifact, file, number, link), every blocker names where it is stuck and who owes the next move, and every plan item has a concrete next action. It flags entries with no evidence, vague quantities such as 很多 / 大幅, vague blockers such as 等反馈 / 看情况, exaggerated wording, and personal data that must be redacted first. Use when the user asks 日报, 周报, 工作日报, 写日报, 生成日报, 日报模板, 周报怎么写, 工作总结, 汇报今天做了什么, 这周做了什么, 整理一下今天的工作, 日报帮我润色, 把这几条整理成日报, 工作汇报, 进度汇报, or says daily report, weekly report, standup notes, status update, work log, what did I do today, summarize my week, turn these notes into a report, progress report, or standup summary.
